title: Among female superheroes with height between 160 and 185 cm who are not hum
question: Among female superheroes with height between 160 and 185 cm who are not human, find the name of the one with the highest speed attribute value.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1."XCL_025" = T3."XCL_016"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T1."XCL_028" BETWEEN 160 AND 185
  AND T3."XCL_017" <> 'Human'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
